test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some computers are phones.

All phones are calculators.

All calculators are i-pads.

**Conclusions:**

1. Some i-pads are computers.

2. All calculators are phones.

3. Some i-pads are phones.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given below according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b4de21767fedd205c737806e14c0438d4c04c0bc6bb1b015bbc921ddd56ed7d.png] 

Conclusions:

1. Some i-pads are computers →** ****Follow **→ As Some computers are phones, All phones are calculators and, All calculators are i-pads. So some i-pads are computer is definitely followed.

2. All calculators are phones → **Does not follow **→ As Some computers are phones, All phones are calculators and, All calculators are i-pads. So all calculators are phones is not definitely followed.

3. Some i-pads are phones → Follow → As All phones are calculators and All calculators are i-pads. So some i-pads are phones is definitely followed.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusions 1 and 3 follow".**
